extraction.name: Arabic-Nougat: Fine-Tuning Vision Transformers for Arabic OCR and Markdown Extraction
extraction.description: We introduce Arabic-Nougat, a suite of OCR models designed to convert Arabic book pages into structured Markdown text. Building on Meta’s Nougat architecture, Arabic-Nougat includes three specialized models: arabic-small-nougat, arabic-base-nougat, and arabic-large-nougat. These models are fine-tuned using a synthetic dataset, arabic-img2md, consisting of 13.7k paired samples of Arabic book pages and their Markdown representations. Key innovations include the Aranizer-PBE-86k tokenizer, which optimizes tokenization efficiency, and the use of torch.bfloat16 precision and Flash Attention 2 for efficient training and inference. Our models significantly outperform existing methods, with arabic-large-nougat achieving the highest Markdown Structure Accuracy and the lowest Character Error Rate. We also release a large-scale dataset of 1.1 billion Arabic tokens extracted from over 8,500 books using our SOTA model, providing a valuable resource for further Arabic OCR research. All models and datasets are open-sourced, and our implementation is available at https://github.com/MohamedAliRashad/arabic-nougat.
extraction.creator: Mohamed A. Rashad
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The primary dataset used for training, arabic-img2md, contains 13.7k paired samples of Arabic book pages and their Markdown representations. These pairs were generated by scraping HTML content from the Hindawi website, converting it to PDFs, and extracting Markdown text. Additionally, arabic-books, a large-scale dataset of 1.1 billion Arabic tokens, was extracted from over 8,500 books using our SOTA model.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: HTML content from the Hindawi website for arabic-img2md. Over 8,500 Arabic books for arabic-books.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: For arabic-img2md, HTML content was converted to PDFs, and then Markdown text was extracted.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: The Donut encoder converts input images into a sequence of 588 tokens (1024-dimensional vectors) through a series of downsampling operations: input image size of 896 ×672 pixels is progressively reduced to 224 ×168, 112 ×84, 56 ×42, and finally 28 ×21, resulting in 588 tokens.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The work aims to promote the digitization of underrepresented languages like Arabic.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The arabic-img2md dataset, derived from Hindawi’s web content, may not generalize well to other domains of Arabic text, such as scientific, religious, or historical documents.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Hallucination in arabic-small-nougat (generates irrelevant content, nonexistent URLs/images). Repetition issues in larger models (arabic-base-nougat and arabic-large-nougat), particularly in lengthy sequences. Dataset biases from Hindawi’s web content may limit generalization to other Arabic text domains. Significant computational resources required for training arabic-large-nougat, limiting accessibility. Performance on multilingual documents or mixed-script content has not been extensively tested. May require additional preprocessing or model adaptations for documents with highly irregular or multi-modal layouts (dense tables, charts, images).
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training and evaluation of OCR models, downstream NLP tasks, Arabic OCR and Markdown extraction tasks. Recommended use of arabic-base-nougat for general text extraction and arabic-large-nougat for lengthy or complex documents.
